title: Chapter 124: Massive Purchases
content:
Chapter 124: Massive Purchases

The population of the caravan is mainly composed of refugees who have lost the protection of their lords. Those refugees whose living territories have been destroyed and no territory is willing to take them in will voluntarily join the caravan to seek refuge.

The reward they can give to the caravan is themselves. The caravan will take them to a territory that lacks population, and the lord who needs them will pay the caravan for them. This is a kind of change of business.

But this model has also saved countless refugees, and it has gained everyone's acquiescence. Even if people from various major races sell in this way, their own people will not cause trouble to the caravan.

In addition to the largest source of refugees, there are many other sources of population, and the reasons are various. Many people from powerful races enter the caravan for various reasons.

Regardless of the source, due to convention, the quality of the caravan's population is still good. They will not be imprisoned and sold like real slaves. In the caravan, they will also help with work and show their value. .

Of course, this is the situation of normal large chamber of commerce caravans. Those abnormal caravans have all kinds of situations. Where there is light, there is darkness, and there will be a dark side everywhere.

The lords of the alliance give priority to the population of their own race. The population of some races in the caravan is very small. Some lords do not find any people of their own race at all, so they can only give up.

The human population in the caravan was not large, so Wu Qing chose to buy all the racial populations that were good at territory construction based on the product introduction list.

He was going to pay with Zerg energy coins. There was no shortage of money now and he could spend it as much as he wanted. It was not easy for the caravan to come here. If there was anything of value, he had to buy it.

The list of goods provided by Gong Zhe was very targeted. They were all goods needed by the alliance lords, but apart from the territory's population, Wu Qing did not need anything else.

When the lords of the alliance were carefully shopping for goods, the Zerg host flew to Gong Zhe's side. It had turned off its own invisibility talent. Gong Zhe would not ignore it and easily noticed this behemoth.

"I still need these territorial populations!"

As soon as the host opened his mouth, he took over everything, almost taking over half of the caravan's territorial population.

"Do you want all of this? You are so generous! These refugees are so lucky!"

Gong Zhe could tell that the host in front of him was not a lord, but he was also very polite. He liked such a big patron very much.

"Excuse me, in addition to the products on these lists, do your caravans have other products?"

"Our lord's needs are somewhat different from those of other lords."

The host continues to communicate with Gong Zhe.

"Of course! Our caravan has a very complete range of products!"

"The list of products in your hand only introduces the products that are in great demand by the lords in this region!"

Gong Zhe quickly waved his hand, and a goblin guard next to him turned back to the goblin transport truck to get something.

"Has your lord stated the specific needs?"

Gong Zhe then asked.

"For example, all kinds of books and all kinds of strange products."

The host spoke.

"Yes! Of course we have them all!"

"There are a lot of books in our caravan, recording the inheritance of civilization and the secrets of history!"

"But these books are valuable. I wonder what kind of books your lords like?"

"Our caravan also has many unique products. Some are collected by the chamber of commerce, some are traded along the caravan, and there are even the proud works of our masters. You can choose and buy as much as you like!"

Gong Zhe finally found a different customer and was so happy that he jumped on top of the guardian's head to communicate with the host.

"I'm so sorry, I can't land on the ground."

Seeing Gong Zhe's actions, the host expressed his apology.

Compared with the goblin, its size was too large, and it was floating in space. It was difficult for Gong Zhe to look at it normally.

"It doesn't matter! I have been in contact with all kinds of races, you don't have to worry!"

Gong Zhe really didn't care and began to introduce some books and special products to the host.

Wu Qing wants books no matter what they record. This can help him better understand the world. Since he came to this world, he has never seen what books in this world are like.

Wu Qing would buy all kinds of special commodities that he felt had a certain value. These things were not very practical. He also wanted to understand the world in a more diversified way.

The host had been listening to Gong Zhe's introduction. The goblin guardian brought a new product list. Gong Zhe handed the list to the host and then introduced the products to the host according to the list. Wu Qing admired his professionalism very much.

"I can only give a brief introduction here. Many good things can only be explained clearly if you see them in action!"

"If you are interested in buying something, please select it. I will send someone to pick it up and explain it to you in detail!"

After Gong Zhe finished talking about the new product list, he seemed to still have some unfinished ideas.

The host can look at the product list and scan it with mental power. Wu Qing and the Insect Queen can see it simultaneously.

Wu Qing briefly discussed with the insect queen and passed the list of goods to be purchased to the host.

The host did not speak, but used his mental power to communicate with Gong Zhe. After obtaining Gong Zhe's consent, he passed the list of goods to be purchased through his mental power.

Gong Zhe looked at the purchase list and looked a little strange. He hesitated before asking the host: "Do you want all these books?"

The host replied affirmatively: "Yes, I want them all."

"These books are of great value. The prices are listed on the product list. Buying them all is not cheap!"

"Coupled with the products you selected and the refugees you just selected, this may require a lot of luck!"

"I suggest you buy fewer books. The content of many books has little real value."

As a businessman, Gong Zhe likes large orders, but in such a remote area, placing such a large order in one territory makes him a little worried about the customer's ability to pay.

If he is just purchasing goods that increase the territory's combat power, he won't say anything. No matter how big the order is, it has its value to the customer.

If the transaction can be completed smoothly, everyone will like it. If it cannot be completed, there will be no joy at most and no loss.

The value of commodities like books is difficult to measure. For those in need, books are priceless treasures. For some people, the value of a book is not as real as a piece of food.

It was also the first time that Gong Zhe encountered Wu Qing purchasing books like this, so he warned him and gave reasonable suggestions.

Wu Qing knew Gong Zhe's worries. At this time, the Zerg energy coins could be released.

The host used his tentacles to hand a bag of large-denomination Zerg energy coins in front of Gong Zhe and said, "Look at these energy coins, what's their value?"
